headline: Get Pomawk
title: How to Get Pomawk in Aniimo | Pomegg at Level 25 | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Pomawk is easy to evolve in Aniimo. Pomegg only needs to reach level twenty five, and that is the only requirement the Aniimo wiki lists. You can also meet a wild Pomawk in Rosetower Woods. Be careful though, because Pomegg has a second path. Dazmand needs level twenty five plus a Roar Stone and special event quests. Pick your path before you evolve. Pomawk or Dazmand? Comment below!
description: Pomegg evolves into Pomawk at level 25, and Pomawk can be found in Rosetower Woods; the Dazmand path needs a Roar Stone and event quests.
